Part Number: SA310C-4G


                                                     SPARKLE Intel® Arc™ A310 ECO, 4GB GDDR6, 50W TBP, Short bracket is included,
                                                     Low-Profile, Single Fan, Single Slot, HDMI x1, Mini DisplayPort x2, SA310C-4G

                                                     SPARKLE exclusive Intel Arc A310 ECO has reduced the power consumption from 75W to 50W, provides
                                                     great performance with lower heat and higher power efficiency.
                                                     With 50W TBP, ECO Series is able to equipped only single-fan, single slot heatsink and half-height
                                                     configuration. Included extra short bracket gave this card even more flexibility.
